yaml:
# HISS H3 (user decisions HD6–HD9 and the 2026-10-16 evening correction). One ObservabilityBinding per Provider consumer,
# named by the Provider id, in opensphere-foundation. spec has one writer, Foundation (from the operand it composed);
# status has one writer, Cluster Manager, which reads bindings only in that namespace.
# Applied by Setup prepare-hiss (create-only). Supersedes the unused Console-only v1alpha1 in observability-binding-controller.yaml.
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: observabilitybindings.observability.opensphere.io
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  group: observability.opensphere.io
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: observabilitybindings
    singular: observabilitybinding
    kind: ObservabilityBinding
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha2
      served: true
      storage: true
      subresources:
        status: {}
      additionalPrinterColumns:
        - { name: Provider, type: string, jsonPath: .spec.consumer.providerId }
        - name: Ready
          type: string
          jsonPath: '.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status'
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          required: [spec]
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required: [consumer, facilities, targets]
              properties:
                consumer:
                  type: object
                  required: [providerId]
                  properties:
                    # The binding's name equals providerId. Cluster Manager identifies the caller from its
                    # Pod-bound token (an admitted Provider revision Pod), so a new revision needs no change here.
                    providerId: { type: string, pattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$' }
                facilities:
                  type: array
                  maxItems: 5
                  x-kubernetes-list-type: map
                  x-kubernetes-list-map-keys: [id]
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: [id]
                    properties:
                      id: { type: string, enum: [metrics, alerts, logs, traces, storage] }
                      required: { type: boolean, default: false }
                targets:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    workloads:
                      type: array
                      maxItems: 16
                      items:
                        type: object
                        required: [namespace, name]
                        properties:
                          namespace: { type: string, pattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$' }
                          name: { type: string, pattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$' }
                    persistentVolumeClaims:
                      type: array
                      maxItems: 16
                      items:
                        type: object
                        required: [namespace, name]
                        properties:
                          namespace: { type: string, pattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$' }
                          name: { type: string, maxLength: 253, pattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]*[a-z0-9])?$' }
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                observedGeneration: { type: integer }
                facilities:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      id: { type: string }
                      required: { type: boolean }
                      state: { type: string, enum: [Available, Degraded, Missing] }
                      reason: { type: string }
                targets:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      kind: { type: string }
                      namespace: { type: string }
                      name: { type: string }
                      state: { type: string, enum: [Present, Missing] }
                conditions:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      type: { type: string }
                      status: { type: string }
                      reason: { type: string }
                      message: { type: string }
                      lastTransitionTime: { type: string, format: date-time }
